final: WITH g AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg1 FROM g), p1 AS (SELECT g.account_id, g.cnt, a1.avg1 FROM g JOIN a1 ON a1.avg1 IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT account_id, cnt, cnt - avg1 AS d1 FROM p1 WHERE cnt > avg1), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg2 FROM k), p2 AS (SELECT k.account_id, k.cnt, k.d1, k.cnt - a2.avg2 AS d2 FROM k JOIN a2 ON a2.avg2 IS NOT NULL) SELECT account_id, cnt, d1, d2 FROM p2 ORDER BY d2 DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
